svg.text: CACE fixture: input buffer + selectable bias,
* all rails on one supply (the pad's iovdd / iovss)
XEd xg xg vext vext sg13_hv_pmos w=5u l=6u
XEm ibias xg vext vext sg13_hv_pmos w=5u l=6u
.options savecurrents method=gear reltol=1e-4 abstol=1e-15 gmin=1e-15 SEED=CACE[CACE{seed=12345} + CACE{iterations=0}]
meas ac t0 find Tdb at=10
meas ac fc when Tdb=0 fall=1
meas ac phc find Tph when Tdb=0 fall=1
meas ac gmdb find Tdb when Tph=-180 cross=1
meas ac t0 find Tdb at=10
meas ac fc when Tdb=0 fall=1
meas ac phc find Tph when Tdb=0 fall=1
meas ac gmdb find Tdb when Tph=-180 cross=1
CACE template: loop gain of the input buffer (fixture s2d_mpdda_pd_sel), differential (Tdm) and common mode (Tcm), broken at vfbp / vfbn
en_3v3 tied to vdd, en_3v3_b to 0; vin = vref (u = 0). vfbp / vfbn drive only gates: DC closed through 1 GH, AC injected through 1 F; first +1 / -1, then +1 / +1.
